'''Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing corporation that, in conjunction with [[Colla Designs/Legends|Colla Designs]], was responsible for, among other things, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]] and [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]. It also provided the superdense and [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] fuel used by the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]].
